t: What Does The Name Eliber Mean?
s: Eliber is a rare masculine given name most plausibly derived from the Latin roots liber (free) or the compound ex + liber (from/into freedom), yielding the sense “the free one” or “one who brings freedom.” In Romance onomastics, Eliber can be read as a learned or regional variant related to Liber, the Roman god associated with liberty and vitality, and to Iber-/Hiber- forms tied to the ancient ethnonym of the Iberian Peninsula.
